name: Handoffs
summary: One agent transfers control of the conversation to another, more specialised agent, which then talks to the user directly. In the OpenAI Agents SDK each handoff is exposed to the model as a tool such as transfer_to_refund_agent. LangChain and other frameworks offer the same pattern.
facts: OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, LangGraph Swarm, LiveKit Agents
Handoff appears to the model as a tool call
Full history passed by default; input filters can trim it
Cheap follow-ups with the active agent, but routing errors move the whole conversation
how: Define specialist agents, each with its own instructions and tools
Expose each specialist to the current agent as a transfer tool
The model calls the transfer tool when the request fits a specialist
The new agent takes over with the conversation history (optionally filtered)
goodFor: Voice agents that switch roles mid-call
Flows where the user talks to each specialist
watchOut: Control does not come back unless you add a return handoff
Long histories get passed along unless filtered
